'''Nolar Fe'li''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Sometime after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Nolar Fe'li worked at the [[Jawa mountain fortress/Legends|Jawa Mountain Fortress]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nolar Fe'li was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']].
